correctness.rationale: Four open neighbourhoods partition sixteen vertices and force induced 2K2. Fixing one code edge, the no-overlap constraints force its antipodal edge, yielding exactly four cosets per direction for sixteen codes. The antipodal quotient is K4,4, intersections exactly reflect incident quotient edges, and the entire exchange graph is L(K4,4). Its 6 neighbours, 9 distance-two states, exact two geodesics, diameter2, absence of one-swaps and 24 four-code partitions all follow. Embedded independent exhaustive and structural checks passed. No higher-dimensional assertion is made.

originality.rationale: Zhou (2016), full arXiv text at §§2–4, already constructs one four-code partition of Q4, and Kwon–Lee (2014) already give the existence and complete-bipartite covering. These general facts are explicitly excluded. The new all-code rigidity statement, 16-state exact two-replacement line-graph identification, shortest-path formula, sharp one-versus-two swap threshold, and complete twenty-four partition count are not found in the material actually read. Multiple targeted searches against research records, own claims and open scientific sources found no dominating result; this is best-knowledge, not a priority certificate. The inaccessible full Kwon–Lee text is a stated residual risk.
residual_risks: The Kwon–Lee (2014) full paper was not accessible; its abstract gives a relevant covering theorem, so an equivalent special-case calculation in its full text cannot be excluded.
A prior equivalent classification or reconfiguration analysis may be indexed under efficient open domination, graph coverings, coding tilings or permutation graphs outside retrieved sources.
This is a small natural graph, so rediscovery of a straightforward counting argument is plausible. No unconditional historical priority is claimed.

value.rationale: Exact open-neighbour sensor layouts on Q4 are a canonical, motivated family with an intrinsic transformation constraint: every intermediate layout must remain a total perfect code. The all-code classification determines a sharp batch-replacement threshold and the exact solution-space metric; the 24 complete partitions quantify globally compatible layouts. This is not a textbook reformulation of the known existence criterion nor an arbitrary subcase selected for a numerical gain; it provides all solutions and their exact mobility on the first nontrivial four-regular binary hypercube.
